facts.content: Our signup funnel currently has 5 steps.
facts.speaker: Maya

facts.content: Last week we saw a 12% drop-off at step 3, the team setup screen.
facts.speaker: Maya

facts.content: The step-3 API latency hasn't changed; it's around 400ms p95.
facts.speaker: Jordan

facts.content: Users on the research calls said step 3 felt confusing; they didn't know why we needed team names upfront.
facts.speaker: Priya

facts.content: Option A (collapse the funnel to 3 steps) is maybe 2 weeks of work; option B (progress indicator) is three days.
facts.speaker: Jordan

assumptions.content: The 12% drop-off at step 3 is driven by friction/confusion, not technical performance.
Users who reach the funnel intend to sign up.

hypotheses.content: Reducing the funnel from 5 steps to 3 lifts signup completion by 15pp within two weeks of shipping.
hypotheses.metric_query: SELECT round(100 * ((countIf(event = 'signup_completed' AND timestamp >= '2026-09-13') / countIf(event = 'signup_started' AND timestamp >= '2026-09-13')) - (countIf(event = 'signup_completed' AND timestamp < '2026-09-13') / countIf(event = 'signup_started' AND timestamp < '2026-09-13'))), 2) AS lift_pp FROM events

options.content: Collapse the funnel from 5 steps to 3.
Keep 5 steps but add a progress indicator.
